name: Neural Implicit Surface Rendering
definition: An implicit differentiable renderer that extends an implicit surface network to produce both geometry-related quantities (signed distance values) and appearance-related quantities. It finds ray-surface intersections using the geometric branch and obtains RGB values from the appearance branch.
summary: Neural Implicit Surface Rendering uses a neural network to represent scenes as implicit functions, distinguishing itself by avoiding mesh extraction and guiding ray marching via signed distance fields.
